{{Quote|A look at its genome strongly suggests the creature is engineered. The patterning is too artificial, too signature to have evolved purely by chance. The big question is who created this pest, and why?|University of Sanbra's Hall of Biological Research Director Saris Uli|<ref name="HNN55" />}}
'''Stone mites''' were [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropods]] that clung to [[Starship/Legends|spaceships]] and buildings, consuming [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] and metal plating with a combination of strong, wire-cutting jaws and [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] saliva. They typically fed on silicates and complex metals, but were also capable of stripping a humanoid to the bone in mere minutes.<ref name="mar28" /> Three individual stone mites could merge to form a symbiotic ternary that featured a hard shell, which strengthened from electrolytic reactions. As a defense, they could weld themselves to a metallic surface and deliver electric shocks through their feeler tails.

[[File:StonemitesNarShaddaa.jpg|thumb|left|115px|Stone mites on Nar Shaddaa, during the Clone Wars]]

Stone mites could be found across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Havricus]], [[Sermeria]],<ref name="HNN53148">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|regional/13321_4.html|Suspicious Package Closes Sermerian First House}}</ref> [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]],<ref name="HNN53153">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|regional/13425_2.html|Tynna to Secede Following Building Disappearance}}</ref> [[Nar Bo Sholla]], and [[Deylerax]].

On [[Ord Tiddell/Legends|Ord Tiddell]], thousands of stone mites infested its capital, [[Lagabee]], with four million planetary residents requesting evacuation. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19.9 BBY]], a freighter called the ''[[Spinner]]'' crashed near [[Westport]] and released an infestation at [[Kishi]]; as a result, [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] ordered their release on [[Orleon]].

There were only a few known manners of eliminating these genetically engineered pests, one of them being [[oxidizer foam]]. When applied, the substance would actually rust the mites to death. Additionally, [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]] could use [[Morichro/Legends|morichro]] against them.

Reports from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] indicated that these creatures were genetically engineered by [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] scientists. While the Arkanian government said that this was not true early in the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], Arkanian scientists were the only scientists to make any progress in destroying stone mites.<ref name="RA SSaSM" /> In actuality, the escaped Arkanian [[mutant]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] created the stone mites for the Separatists.<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> 

In [[137 ABY]], stone mites on Coruscant appeared to be deformed from the sabotage of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]].
